claim: For the single-species PVBS Hamiltonian on the diagonal half-space \(D=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb Z^2:x+y\ge0\}\) with equal couplings \(0<\lambda<1\), the one-particle Bloch fiber at boundary quasimomentum \(k\in[-\pi,\pi]\) has a unique eigenvalue below its bulk band, \(E_{\mathrm{edge}}(k)=\frac{2\lambda^2}{1+\lambda^2}\sin^2(k/2)\), with transverse decay ratio \(r(k)=\lambda\cos(k/2)\) and exact separation \(\frac{2(1-\lambda\cos(k/2))^2}{1+\lambda^2}\) from the bulk-band lower edge.

integrity.proof_basis: Analytic reduction to a half-line Jacobi operator with a separate endpoint calculation at \( |k|=\pi \).

scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the one-particle Bloch fibers of the equal-coupling diagonal PVBS half-space with \(0<\lambda<1\).
The fiber eigenvectors are normalizable only in the inward normal coordinate, not along the infinite boundary.
No full many-particle spectral classification, anisotropic-coupling result, or perturbation stability result is claimed.
title: Exact edge band for the diagonal PVBS half-space
